name: Fixture 4: long and short compression members
note: Spec 5 fixture 4, issue W1-03. Do not modify these numbers without human approval. Line 1 is the short column (member 1, length 1) and line 2 the long column (member 2, length 2). Each rises from a fixed base, and both share section 1. The capacity check treats both columns as fixed-fixed with no sidesway (effectiveLengthFactor K = 0.5). A node's fixed flag restrains all six degrees of freedom, so the tops stay free in the geometry. Under the same compression the long column buckles first; expectedCriticalLoad is pi^2 * E * I / (K * L)^2 in N. Capacity tests read member lengths from the node positions with no room-to-bridge scale. cy and cz are outer-fiber distances that only the bending check reads; these columns carry no moment.
